# Vendored: morphicons 2.0.2

Unmodified build files from the npm package `morphicons` 2.0.2 (MIT, see LICENSE),
https://github.com/guillermolg00/morphicons. Kept here so the site does not depend on an outside CDN.

Icon paths in `index.html` (play, pause, rotate-ccw, chevron-right, chevron-down, chevron-up) come from
Lucide 1.68.0 (ISC), https://lucide.dev. Pause is Lucide's two rectangles written as one path.

If these files fail to load, the page keeps its plain text symbols.
